meta.title: Frequently asked questions — Mobilcab
meta.description: Straight answers about Mobilcab: installing, pricing, the Free and Cut list plans, and the product roadmap.

hero.label: Frequently asked questions
hero.title: Straight answers, before you sign up.
hero.body: If you can't find what you're looking for, write to us. We answer personally.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
a: No. Mobilcab runs straight from your browser, on a laptop. Nothing to install, no license server.

items.q: Does it work on tablet or phone?
a: Not yet — it's built for laptop. Tablet and phone optimization come later.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
a: The cut list (dimensions, quantities, materials) is the workshop foundation.
Dedicated machine export comes with the CNC stage on the Roadmap and the CNC plan. It is not included in the Cut list plan at paid launch.

They're the stages on the Roadmap, in order. M1 = Cut list (3D design + parts list — free now). M2 = nesting, labels and quotes (the Atelier plan, when we ship it). M3 = CNC export. M4 = team and sharing. M5 = AI + renders.
Subscriptions can open with the paid Cut list plan before nesting is ready. Elsewhere we talk about subscriptions, not M-codes.
Now: Free = full Cut list, no export limits. We are not charging. For 20% off paid plans, join the Founding Partner waitlist (it closes when billing opens).

At billing: Free gets 3 downloads per account; the paid Cut list plan keeps unlimited exports. Founding Partners on the list: 20% off for 6 months from first payment on paid plans that ship in that window. Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. We announce amounts then.

items.q: How is Free different from the Cut list plan?
a: Now only Free exists: full Cut list (3D, list, cloud), with no download limits.

When subscriptions open: Free stays Cut list with 3 downloads per account; paid Cut list is the same product with unlimited exports. Next come Atelier, CNC, Production, AI — each adds what is on the Roadmap. Founding Partners: 20% / 6 months; the waitlist closes at billing.
after: We do not charge until the paid Cut list plan opens. List prices are confirmed then. Higher plans appear on Pricing as coming soon until we ship them.
